actions.name: goto
actions.description: Opens a URL in the page; relative URLs resolve against the environment base URL.

actions.name: back
actions.description: Goes back one page in the browser history.

actions.name: reload
actions.description: Reloads the page.

actions.name: click
actions.description: Clicks an element.

actions.name: fill
actions.description: Clears a field and types a value.

actions.name: select
actions.description: Selects an option, by value or label, in a select element.

actions.name: check
actions.description: Checks a checkbox or radio button, or unchecks it with checked: false.

actions.name: hover
actions.description: Moves the mouse over an element.

actions.name: press
actions.description: Presses a key or chord, on an element or on the focused element.

actions.name: upload
actions.description: Sets the files of a file input; paths are relative to the step file.

actions.name: drag
actions.description: Drags one element onto another.

actions.name: wait.element
actions.description: Waits until an element is visible, hidden, attached or detached.

actions.name: wait.url
actions.description: Waits until the page URL matches a pattern.

actions.name: wait.response
actions.description: Waits for a response whose URL matches, including one that arrived since the previous step started.

actions.name: expect.visible
actions.description: Checks that an element is visible, or hidden with visible: false.

actions.name: expect.text
actions.description: Checks an element's text.

actions.name: expect.value
actions.description: Checks a field's value.

actions.name: expect.url
actions.description: Checks the page's URL.

actions.name: expect.count
actions.description: Checks how many elements a target matches.

actions.name: expect.response
actions.description: Checks a response: its status, part of its JSON, or text in its body.

actions.name: set
actions.description: Sets one or more variables.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: Reads an element's text, value or attribute into a variable.

actions.name: api
actions.description: Sends an HTTP request signed in like the page, and optionally stores the response.

actions.name: mock
actions.description: Answers matching requests with a fixed response until the test ends.

actions.name: call
actions.description: Runs a flow with parameters; its outputs become variables.
